source_summary: A sparse riverscape with a left rocky bank and landing, a covered ferry boat with figures, clustered willows, foreground rocks and shrubs, and fine water-ripple linework. Red seals, inscriptions, borders, and paper texture are excluded from all motifs.

motifs.name: left_cliff_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the tall eroded rock bank rising along the left edge, including the sweeping vertical cliff contours, fissures, dark ink accents, root-like base forms, and pale ink washes; exclude seals, the landing structure, boat, and separate leaf sprays where possible.
must_preserve: dark ink notches and hollows at the base
curving root-like rock forms near the waterline

motifs.name: left_hanging_willow_spray
motifs.description: Isolate the drooping willow foliage attached to the left cliff, with narrow leaf clusters cascading downward beside the rock face; keep only the leaf sprays and their fine stems, not the full cliff or landing.
must_preserve: alternating dark and pale ink leaves

motifs.name: wooden_river_landing
motifs.description: Isolate the partial wooden landing and bridge-like platform at the lower left, including vertical posts, railings, plank edges, and the stone or timber base at the water; exclude the cliff, boat, and inscriptions.

motifs.name: covered_ferry_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the long covered river boat, including the pointed hull, roofed cabin, railings, posts, oar/pole fittings, and passengers seated or standing on board; exclude nearby landing, foreground rocks, and willow branches not touching the boat.
must_preserve: arched canopy roof and scalloped eave marks
rectangular railing and cabin post geometry
fine figure linework inside and beside the cabin
subtle ink wash on roof and hull

motifs.name: boat_figures_group
motifs.description: Isolate the human figures associated with the boat: the standing poleman, seated companion near the bow area, and seated passenger in the cabin, including their robes, faces, hands, and the long punting pole; exclude the boat structure except where strokes physically overlap the figures.
must_preserve: bent standing posture of the poleman
seated compact posture of the companion

motifs.name: central_low_willow_thicket
motifs.description: Isolate the lower central willow thicket behind and around the boat roof, with rounded clumps of pendant leaves and thin branching stems; exclude the boat cabin and the taller right willow trunks.
must_preserve: dark ink accents at leaf bases
soft transparent wash within the foliage

motifs.name: right_tall_willow_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the large willow grove on the right, including the tall leaning trunks, arching branches, dense hanging curtains of leaves, and the smaller adjacent tree stems; exclude foreground rocks, boat, seals, and empty paper.
must_preserve: curving trunk outlines with textured bark washes
individual leaf clusters in dark ink
subtle tonal variation in trunks and leaves

motifs.name: foreground_rocks_and_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground rock garden at the bottom center, including jagged rocks, low shrubs, small leafy plants, and the base of the willow trunk where it joins the rocks; exclude the boat and broad water surface.
must_preserve: wrinkled texture strokes and dark crevices
tiny plant stems and ink dots
organic transition into the willow-root base

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
